thread:
Nikhil: FYI vendor Invoice #ZEN-3344 charged no tax but AP applied backup withholding 24% because EFT W-9 name/EIN mismatch flagged by Coupa. Invoice USD 5,000. PDF: https://invoices.example.com/ZEN-3344.pdf

Rae: Wait, backup withholding? That's for incorrect TIN/name with IRS B-notice rules. Did AP get a B-notice or did Coupa auto-flag?

AP: Coupa autoflagged when the W-9 name didn't match EIN on IRS TIN match. No manual B-notice served yet. We flagged hold and processed a 24% withholding on the payable to be safe.

Nikhil: Oof. Vendor called upset. They say the W-9 we have is for "Zenith Analytics LLC" but their legal name changed to "Zenith AI Solutions Inc" last month. They uploaded W-9 with new name but the EIN is the same.

TaxOps: Two paths: (1) If vendor provides a corrected W-9 and we confirm IRS TIN match, reverse withholding before remittance (best). (2) If funds already remitted to IRS under backup withholding, vendor must file refund claim. Also confirm whether contract requires gross-up (rare).

vendor-support: Vendor message: "We updated our W-9 and attached a signed doc showing name change and the same EIN. Can you stop the withholding and pay out? We weren't notified of any B-notice." Link to W-9: https://coupa.example.com/docs/w9/zen-3344.pdf

AP: Remittance not yet sent; scheduled for 2026-06-02. We can pause. Need TaxOps sign-off to unhold and reverse the withheld line.

Rae: Quick checklist: 1) validate name change docs (incorporation amendment or DBA?) 2) re-run IRS TIN match (SS-4 cross-check) 3) update vendor master and attach W-9. If cleared, AP to release full payment and reverse withholding entry in GL. 4) communicate to vendor.

TaxOps: I will run TIN match now. If match OK and supporting docs show legal name change linked to same EIN, we reverse withholding. No gross-up; vendor isn't entitled to gross-up unless contract explicitly says so.

payroll-bot: Event: tin_match_check queued (vendor=ZEN-3344, status=pending)

AP: Holding actioned. If TaxOps clears, AP will create reversing journal and pay net USD 5,000. If vendor insists on gross-up, escalate to procurement for contract review.

Nikhil: Also note internal comms: update vendor onboarding to require legal-name-change docs and a short holding rule: AP should notify vendor and offer 10 business days to provide docs before withholding. That should cut these surprises down.

TaxOps: TIN match returned OK. Name variation acceptable per IRS guidance when legal-name-change docs provided. Clearing for reversal. Tagging @AP to proceed.

AP: Reversal in process. We'll attach the W-9 and name-change PDF to the payment record and notify vendor. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
